import datetime
import calendar

def next_billing_date(start: datetime.date, months_ahead: int) -> datetime.date:
    if months_ahead < 0:
        raise ValueError("months_ahead must be non-negative")
    new_year = start.year + (start.month - 1 + months_ahead) // 12
    new_month = (start.month - 1 + months_ahead) % 12 + 1
    max_day = calendar.monthrange(new_year, new_month)[1]
    new_day = min(start.day, max_day)
    return datetime.date(new_year, new_month, new_day)
